messages:
oncall-bot: PAGER: P1 - elevated tail latency (>800ms) observed for text-generation API in west1. Incident INC-2024-4512. Paging oncall-sre. Please ack.
Sam H: Acked. I'm oncall but have a scheduled handoff in ~12m. Mira, can you take primary after I hand over? I can drive until I leave.
Mira K: I can take primary in ~10m — currently finishing a deploy review. I'll be ready to take over at 1739525340.
Sam H: Perfect. I'll keep driving until then. Ingrid, can you own comms for now? We'll need a brief customer update and the incident timeline.
Ingrid L: I can own comms. Posting initial message to #status-page now. Template: "We are investigating elevated latency for text generation in west1. Impact: intermittent high tail latency. Mitigation in progress. Next update in 15m." Will include link to incident. :loudspeaker:
Sam H: Quick checklist for whoever's driving: 1) check autoscaler & pod restarts 2) look at batch queue depth on infer-svc 3) examine KV cache hit-rate 4) validate recent model rollout/quantization changes. Runbook: https://redwood/internal/runbooks/p1-latency
Mira K: Noted. I'll check model variants and canary percentages. If we see increased CPU on transformer nodes, we should lower concurrency or revert canary.
DeployBot: Deploy: service=infer-svc region=west1 commit=ab12ef3 status=SUCCESS ts=1739524000
Sam H: Deploy landed ~11m ago. Could be related. Mira, look at canary ratio and inference kernel metrics (seq len distribution). Command: `kubectl -n prod logs deploy/infer-svc -c runtime | tail -n 200`
Mira K: Running that now, also pulling metrics: `grafana/dashboard/d/srv-infer/west1` — seeing a spike in token service latency and CPU p95 on gpu-pool-2. KV cache hit-rate dropped from 92% -> 64% around 1739523600.
Sam H: That timestamp aligns with deploy. Action plan: (A) roll canary back to 0% (B) scale up dedicated pool if rollback not quick (C) enable degraded fallback model if rollout sticky. I'll start rollback in 2m unless Mira advises otherwise.
Ingrid L: Posting update to customers: "We've identified a recent deployment that correlates with increased latency. Teams are reverting the canary and performing mitigations. We will update in 10 minutes."
Mira K: Go ahead with rollback now, Sam. I'm switching to primary at 1739525340 — will verify health after rollback and run regression prompts.
Sam H: Rolling canary back to 0% now. Command: `redwoodctl rollout set infer-svc --canary-percent 0 --region west1`
Sam H: Returned: OK. Observability: p95 latency dropping in graphs, KV cache hit-rate recovering slowly.
Mira K: Confirming: p95 down ~30% and error rate stable. I am primary now. Sam, thanks for driving.
Sam H: Handoff complete. I'm signing off as primary at 1739525340 and moving to secondary watch for the next 30m.
Ingrid L: Sending final update to customers: "Canary has been reverted and latency is improving; monitoring continues. Next update in 30 minutes or on significant change." (posted to #status-page) :white_check_mark:
Mira K: I'll continue to monitor for 30m and run the postmortem checklist: capture traffic profile, confirm fallback logic, and add a synthetic check for KV cache regression.
Sam H: Thanks all. If anything pops, ping @mira directly or escalate to infra-oncall.
Ingrid L: I'll update the incident ticket and assign comms to myself for the duration.
oncall-bot: Incident INC-2024-4512 status changed: DRIVER=Mira K, COMMS=Ingrid L, SECONDARY=Sam H.
Mira K: Closing the loop here — I'll open a follow-up retro doc with proposed guardrails for canaries and cache monitoring.
Sam H: Thanks team. Signing out.
Ingrid L: I'll post the post-incident customer note after the retro draft is ready.
